status: selection and gates frozen after identifier/radius-only overlap audit and before fitting the ACCEPT-matched CLASH outcomes
question: Does a shared local-density response predict held-out galaxy dynamics and the measured radial shape of CLASH lensing accelerations once the galaxy-cluster density gap is filled with Chandra profiles?

datasets.cluster_local_density: Cavagnolo et al. 2009 ACCEPT electron-density profiles
datasets.cluster_accelerations: Tian et al. 2020 CLASH baryonic and lensing-derived radial accelerations
datasets.galaxy_dynamics: same 44 quality-selected Tian et al. 2024 MaNGA BCG plus DynPop sample used by CPR0-0.4

observable_construction.electron_density_interpolation: linear interpolation in log10(ne) versus log10(radius)
observable_construction.primary_reason: ACCEPT measures hot gas but not local BCG/ICL stellar density; the omission is most serious at the 14-24 kpc points
observable_construction.extrapolation: forbidden; a CLASH row is selected only inside the ACCEPT midpoint range
observable_construction.coherence: C=0 for every cluster point; the cluster catalog has no independent coherence observable

prior_joint_RG_median_fold_fit.source: median fold parameters from CPR0-0.4, fixed before the ACCEPT-CLASH score

prior_joint_CPR0_median_fold_fit.source: median fold parameters from CPR0-0.4, fixed before the ACCEPT-CLASH score

cross_validation.group: cluster identifier or BCG plateifu; all radial points for a held-out cluster remain in one fold
cross_validation.objective: equal-domain mean of equal-system mean squared log10 acceleration residual

claim_boundary: The CLASH target is a spherical acceleration derived from a joint lens-model posterior, not a raw shear catalog, and its public table omits radial covariance.
The primary density is measured hot gas; stellar and intracluster-light density are not included locally.
The outcome table and earlier results were already known, so the joint refit is exploratory even though this exact match, selection, and gates were fixed before fitting.
C=0 makes the cluster-only test a density-response test, not a test of the coherence interpolation.
The zero-slip acceleration mapping is still provisional until a relativistic action derives photon propagation.
